notes.title: Check out Spaceland - Out Now
notes.content:
Greetings everyone!

Today we would like to share some exciting news with you: our new story based strategy Spaceland has been released!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5779506/3897e043e7194aa8ea8d90cb8573364fac3f360d.gif[/img]

Spaceland is an incredibly dynamic turn-based strategy, reviving the traditions of XCOM, Incubation and Laser Squad. Lead a team of the most desperate fighters, destroy alien monsters and uncover the secrets of the lost planet.

[previewyoutube=myAlbM8H2uc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Top Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*] The game is inspired by the best turn-based strategies of the old school - XCOM, Incubation, Laser Squad
[*] A unique blend of dynamic turn-based battles lasting 10-15 minutes
[*] Make a squad from 7 space rangers, each with a unique fighting style
[*] The story of the mysterious planet in the spirit of the «golden age» of science fiction
[/list]

Support our new game with story in Braveland style and start the space adventure!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1021070/Spaceland/

notes.title: Update: fast battles and two new languages
notes.content:
Hi, Bravelanders!

[h1]Spanish and Simplified Chinese added![/h1]
New languages appeared - Simplified Chinese and Spanish. Great work of translators. Hope it helps more people to become real Bravelanders.

[h1]Fast animations mode[/h1]
We've added fast battle mode that speeds up all animations! So you can play the game at your own pace. We've tested new mode and it's gorgeous. Almost faster than light. :)

[h1]Grind issues in Braveland Wizard fixed[/h1]
This week we've fixed grind issues in Braveland Wizard. Hurray! No more repetitive battles. Dungeons give you more gold to hire new troops. Start of the game is easier. That fixes affects all three difficulties so you can try it and say us is it ok or not.

In case you forgot what Braveland Wizard is:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/333880/Braveland_Wizard/

Thanks for reading this post to the end. Have a nice day!

notes.title: New unit in Survival Mode.
notes.content:
Hi, Bravelanders.

We've released the second book of our game - Braveland Wizard and add a brand new fighter from it in Survival Mode to Braveland - Elementalist. Try it out and prepare you for new adventures with wizardress from cold north.

List of features and fixes in Braveland:

- Elementalist from Braveland Wizard appeared in Survival Mode
- Survival Mode is more difficult now
- Health Bar Mode added in battle interface together with many other UI improvements
- Minor fixes and improvements

 [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/333880/]Braveland Wizard on Steam[/url]

Tortuga Team.

notes.title: Survival Mode is now available!
notes.content:
Hello, Bravelanders.  

It's been a month since we've launched Braveland on Steam. Since the launch we've been reviewing all feedback and have come up with a new [b]Survival Mode[/b] for you! Play as much as you want. Test your battle skills.  

What's new: 
* First of all a new Survival Mode! 
* Game now supports German 
* Game now supports French 
* 5 Trading Cards 
* Some minor bugs have been fixed.

[url=store.steampowered.com/app/285800/][h1]Play Braveland[/h1][/url]
